    • PortalSession: string

      Description

      The session_token returned by verifyPortalLogin. A bearer credential for ONE contact — the site's server keeps it in an HttpOnly cookie and forwards it here. Missing answers 401 PORTAL_SESSION_REQUIRED; unknown, expired or revoked answers 401 PORTAL_SESSION_INVALID.

      • author_user_id: string | null
      • body: string
      • conversation_id: string

        Description

        Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

      • delivery_error: string | null

        Description

        Last send error for a failed outbound message, otherwise null.

      • delivery_status: "pending" | "sent" | "delivered" | "failed" | null

        Description

        Outbound delivery state, or null for inbound messages and internal notes. A 201 from POST /api/v1/helpdesk/replies means the reply was accepted, NOT delivered — the channel hand-off is asynchronous, so poll this field (or subscribe to helpdesk.message_delivery_updated) to learn the outcome.

      • externally_deleted_at: number | null

        Description

        Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the customer deleted the message on the external channel (Telegram today), otherwise null. The message is kept as a tombstone so the thread still reads in order, but its body is empty and any attachment has been erased — mirror the deletion in your own store. Also delivered as the helpdesk.message_deleted webhook event.

      • id: string
      • message_type: "email" | "chat" | "note"

      Description

      Body for startBookingPayment and startManageBookingPayment.

      • return_url: string

        Description

        Where the wallet returns the customer. Must be a URL one of this workspace's own sites vouches for; anything else answers 422.

      • terms_accepted: true

        Description

        Must be literally true. The customer has to actively accept the merchant's terms BEFORE a payment is initiated, so omitting it or sending false is a 400 and leaves no payment behind.

        Constant

      • Optionalterms_text?: string

        Description

        The exact text that was accepted, stored with the consent record.

      • Optionalterms_version?: string

        Description

        The caller's own version label for the terms that were accepted.

      Description

      A delivery attempt record. id is the same value sent as the X-Medal-Delivery-Id and Idempotency-Key headers on the outbound request. Deliveries never carry payload bodies (payloads can contain customer PII). The correlation fields are derived from the stored event and fail closed to null when no canonical event exists — e.g. test.ping deliveries or events that have aged out of retention.
